title: The RAF Flew Cats To A Village Full Of Rats 🐈
caption:
The RAF flew cats to a village drowning in rats 🐈
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1960 the Royal Air Force delivered cats to a remote village in Borneo that was overrun by rats. The story says pest spraying had killed the local cats. The flight is documented, but the huge numbers and the parachutes are disputed. Records suggest only a small number of cats.
Cat or trap? 👇
first_comment: The story got bigger with every retelling. How many cats do you think it really was? 🐈👇
